selectionRules.preferential: AIP preferential configuration: the first configuration (in order) whose runways are within the wind limits.
selectionRules.approach: No AIP preference: the runway with the best approach (approachRanking) if within the wind limits, otherwise the runway the wind suits best. Equal approach: most headwind; equal and calm: keep the current configuration (at startup the first listed).

LEBL.source: AIP España AD 2-LEBL, AD 2.20 'Configuraciones preferentes' and LVP section, AIRAC AMDT 09/26 (WEF 01-OCT-26)
notes: Day departures: 24R (west) / 06L (east) only for aircraft that justify needing the longer runway.
Night: if RWY 02 cannot be used for arrivals, west configuration. The AIP's last-resort east night configuration is left out (no runway closures on VATSIM).
Night configuration may be extended past 0700 LT or started before 2300 LT when traffic allows.
Preferential configurations are also suspended with braking action below good, wind shear or thunderstorms.

LEPA.source: AIP España AD 2-LEPA, AD 2.20 'Uso de pista - Pistas preferentes', AIRAC AMDT 09/26 (WEF 01-OCT-26)
notes: West: RWY 24R may also be used for arrivals at ATC's initiative to expedite arrivals.
East: RWY 06L may also be used for departures at ATC's initiative to expedite departures.

LEIB.source: AIP España AD 2-LEIB, AD 2.20 'Uso de pista - Pista preferente', AIRAC AMDT 06/26
notes: RWY 24 preferred for environmental reasons (both ends have ILS CAT I).

LERS.source: AIP España AD 2-LERS, AD 2.20 'Pista preferente', AMDT 409/26
notes: AIP: 'la pista preferente es la RWY 25'. No wind limit given, default limits apply. RWY 25 also has the ILS.

LEAM.source: AIP España AD 2-LEAM, AD 2.19 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 09/26

LECH.source: AIP España AD 2-LECH, AD 2.19 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 07/26

LEDA.source: AIP España AD 2-LEDA, AD 2.19, AD 2.22 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 05/26
notes: AIP AD 2.22: THR 31 preferred for departures of code C or larger aircraft.

LELC.source: AIP España AD 2-LELC, AD 2.12 + AD 2.19 + IAC chart list, AMDT 405/26
notes: RWY 04L/22R is military use only (AD 2.12 note 4) and is never selected.
Also listed in LECM.json: near the FIR boundary, the other FIR gives STAR/descent clearances.
No instrument approach procedures: chosen by wind only.

LEMI.source: AIP España AD 2-LEMI, AD 2.19 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 05/26

LEZG.source: AIP España AD 2-LEZG, AD 2.19, AD 2.20 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 09/26
notes: Preferential: 30R (ILS CAT II/III), per VATSIM Spain operations. In the 12 direction, arrivals 12R (VOR/NDB/TACAN approaches) and departures 12L.
Also listed in LECM.json: near the FIR boundary, the other FIR gives STAR/descent clearances.

LEGE.source: AIP España AD 2-LEGE, AD 2.19 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 09/26

LESU.source: AIP España AD 2-LESU, AD 2.22 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 09/26
notes: RNP RWY 03 minima type not in the chart title; ranked as LNAV. RWY 21 landings by visual circling only.

LEMH.source: AIP España AD 2-LEMH, AD 2.19 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 09/26

LEVC.source: AIP España AD 2-LEVC, AD 2.19 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 07/26

LEAL.source: AIP España AD 2-LEAL, AD 2.19 + IAC chart list, AIRAC AMDT 09/26
